description: Dry-run checkout for an exact published offer. Returns validation JSON text with offer readiness or errors and missing requirements. Inspect the offer with nexez_get_page first. Never charges or creates an order; a successful check is not a completed purchase.

buyerEmail.description: Optional buyer-provided email for checkout context. Omit when unnecessary; never invent personal details.

buyerReference.description: Optional buyer-provided reference for checkout context; omit if none was supplied.

deliveryPostalCode.description: Buyer-provided delivery ZIP for a local delivery product whose product.local_delivery.zips is listed. Omit otherwise.

offer.description: Exact offer key from the listing manifest, for example services-0 or products-1. Do not invent an index.

offerConfiguration.description: Buyer-selected configuration values keyed exactly as defined by the target offer configuration schema from nexez_get_page. Supply required fields for that offer; do not invent values or use a generic schema.

quantity.description: Units to buy for a product offer; defaults to 1. Stay within product.max_per_order and product.stock_count from nexez_get_page.

shippingAddress.description: Required for a shipped product (fulfillment "shipped"): the buyer-provided US address. Shipping is the flat rate for its region from product.shipping. Never invent an address.

slug.description: Exact published listing slug returned by discovery, not a full URL.

variant.description: Exact variant id from product.variants in nexez_get_page. Required when the product lists variants; do not invent one.

name: nexez_validate_checkout
title: Validate Nexez checkout
